The web text of MIL section 5.2 includes this text:

See if you can fill in the missing parts of the proof below. At the very end, you can use Nat.dvd_sub' and Nat.dvd_mul_right to finish it off.

Unless I'm misunderstanding something, Nat.dvd_sub' has been removed from Mathlib. (Or rather, Nat.dvd_sub has been removed, and Nat.dvd_sub' has been renamed to take its place.)
https://mathlib-changelog.org/v4/theorem/Nat.dvd_sub' does seem to show it's gone, yeah
The changelog missed it but it was actually removed in #30759 rather than #23614
